This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Talsara PS Case No.114 of 2023 corresponding to Spl. GR Case No.71 of 2023 pending in the file of learned Additional District Judge-Cum-Presiding Officer, Special Court under POCSO Act,
Sundargarh, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.376-AB/363/506 of IPC r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about less than 12 years.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-Cum-Presiding Officer, Special Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Heard, Ms. Mohini Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M.K. Mohanty, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record including the copy of deposition of the victim.

None appears for the informant/victim despite being duly intimated as apprised by learned Addl. PP.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the allegation sought to be brought against him and on going through the other materials placed on record together with the evidence of the victim, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
5. Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
(G. Satapathy) Judge Subhasmita Location: High Court of Orissa Niroj @ Dinabandhu Singh vs State Of Orissa ...
